d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have new senior leadership opportunities in our Global Alliances and Channels organisations, to lead business development and partnership with some of the most important actors in the global technology sector. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.

These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.

Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.

Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.
Location: These are globally remote positions.
Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market
Lead and evolve a team or strategic partner portfolio towards accelerated revenue growth and market impact

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

d: Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform that helps organizations understand customer conversations, uncover actionable insights, and improve customer experiences through advanced AI capabilities.
As the platform continues to grow, maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing data infrastructure is critical to supporting our customers and enabling continuous product innovation.

Our database environment spans multiple cloud platforms and hosting environments, supporting business-critical workloads, high-volume data ingestion, and multi-tenant applications. We are looking for a Database Administrator who can help strengthen our database operations, improve resilience, and ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable as we scale.

Our database infrastructure is growing in both scale and complexity. With production PostgreSQL and MySQL environments running across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and our in-Kingdom hosting environment, maintaining database availability, performance, and recoverability is essential to the reliability of our platform.

As a Database Administrator, you’ll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You’ll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations.

You’ll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered.

If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments.
Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity.
Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization.
Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery.
Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies.
Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes.
Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing.
Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools.
Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability.
You’ve developed a clear understanding of the production database estate across AWS, GCP, and SITE.
You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures.
You’ve built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams.
You’ve identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery.
You’re independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities.
You’ve reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases.
You’ve identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat.
You’re contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation.
Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined.
Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks.
Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks.
You’re actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives.
A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning.
A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed.
The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented.
Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative.
q: You’re an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure.
You’re comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability.
Have 3 years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production.
Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases.
Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery.
Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations.
Can automate database operations using Bash or Python.
When it comes to database resilience
You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover.
You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime.
You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans.
When it comes to database performance
You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization.
You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges.
You take ownership and remain calm under pressure.
You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
You document your work and continuously improve database reliability.
Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas.
Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements.
Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G.
Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments.
Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation.
Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning.
Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications.
What the hiring process will look like
Technical deep-dive (60–90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade — [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead]
Hiring manager interview — Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager

d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

Four Seasons Residences Bahrain is a complex with 112 bespoke private residences, ranging in size from 109 square meters to 737 square meters. The residences are located in the heart of Bahrain Bay and are connected to the Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay by a private and secure pedestrian bridge.

As one of the leaders in branded residences since 1982, Four Seasons currently operate 50 residential properties around the world and 90% of the projects in our pipeline contain a residential component.

Operating from the Residential Lobby and Front Drive, the Guest Service Agent is an integral part of the Residential Services Team whose main objective is to ensure our residents are well looked after from the start. As the first and last impression of the Four Seasons Private Residences, this high-profile department carries a special responsibility. The Guest Service Agent is stationed at the bell stand outside the building and greets each resident by name upon arrival and departure. The Guest Service Agent transports luggage to the residences for arrivals and transports luggage for departing residents to the entrance or into temporary storage. The Guest Service Agent also provides arriving residents with a Four Seasons Private Residences orientation.

Responds to a wide variety of homeowner requests by accurately assessing the resident’s needs and inquiries; offering personal recommendations and personalized touches to achieve maximum resident satisfaction while complying with all Four Seasons’ policies.

Assist residents with luggage, transportation requirements, deliveries, parcels, wine deliveries, groceries, etc. following instructions as specified in the Residence Unit Admittance Forms. Maintains proper records of deliveries and pick-up.

Assists residents, visitors, and/or vendors in all inquiries in connection with residential common areas, hours of operations, key residences personnel, directions, etc. Must be familiar with all common areas and services offered at the residences.
Greets all residents and their guests passing through lobby and offers them assistance
Assists in Residential Lobby service - answer telephones at the residences Concierge Desk, deliver messages, packages, laundry, groceries, etc. to units
Assists in Common Area service – setup the space, provide food and beverage service, assistance with operating equipment etc. to owners
Deliveries in-residence dining requests from 3rd party vendors to unit as requested
Ensures the residences lobby is always clean, including bell carts and storage area.
Complies with Four Seasons Work Rules and Standards of Conduct
Works harmoniously and professionally with co-workers and supervisors
Ability to use variety of IT systems to perform his own duties and assist homeowners on basic functionality.
